MOD = 10**9 + 7

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.N = size
        self.A = [[0] * (size + 1) for _ in range(size + 1)]
        
    def __mul__(self, other):
        C = Matrix(self.N)
        for i in range(self.N + 1):
            for j in range(self.N + 1):
                val = 0
                for k in range(self.N + 1):
                    val += self.A[i][k] * other.A[k][j]
                C.A[i][j] = val % MOD
        return C

def main():
    N, K = map(int, input().split())
    dig = []
    while N:
        dig.append(N % K)
        N //=K
    cnt = len(dig)
    
    A = [[Matrix(K) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(cnt)]
    sum_matrices = [[Matrix(K) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(cnt)]
    suf = [[Matrix(K) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(cnt)]
    ans = Matrix(K)
    
    for i in range(K):
        m = Matrix(K)
        for j in range(K + 1):
            m.A[j][j] = 1
            m.A[j][i] = 1
        m.N = K
        A[0][i] = m
    
    sum_matrices[0][0] = A[0][0]
    suf[0][K - 1] = A[0][K - 1]
    for i in range(1, K):
        sum_matrices[0][i] = sum_matrices[0][i - 1] * A[0][i]
    for i in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
        suf[0][i] = A[0][i] * suf[0][i + 1]
    
    for i in range(1, cnt):
        A[i][0] = suf[i - 1][0]
        for j in range(1, K):
            A[i][j] = suf[i - 1][j] * sum_matrices[i - 1][j - 1]
        sum_matrices[i][0] = A[i][0]
        suf[i][K - 1] = A[i][K - 1]
        for j in range(1, K):
            sum_matrices[i][j] = sum_matrices[i][j - 1] * A[i][j]
        for j in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
            suf[i][j] = A[i][j] * suf[i][j + 1]
    
    ans.A[0][K] = 1
    ans.N = K
    ans = ans * sum_matrices[cnt - 1][dig[cnt - 1] - 1]
    last = dig[cnt - 1]
    for i in range(cnt - 2, -1, -1):
        for j in range(dig[i]):
            ans = ans * A[i][(j + last) % K]
        last += dig[i]
    res = 0
    for i in range(K + 1):
        res += ans.A[0][i]
    print(res % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
